verdict.rationale: Anytype documents an official MCP server that lets AI assistants work with its API through natural language. It also ships an open-source Agents Skill toolkit that drops into Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI and GitHub Copilot to read, search, modify and script against Objects. Both run on a localhost API with a published OpenAPI spec, which together amount to first-party connectors for external LLMs and AI tools. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP and skill integrations, and evidence of a broader in-app AI plugin ecosystem beyond the localhost API-based connectors.
